svg.text: Cars in the way: what the engine offers
Each free cell ahead of you shows the move points it costs, or a cross when it is not offered.
Zones left to right, lanes top to bottom; the number in a plain dot is its forwardIndex.
A lane change passes one car in its lane, never the second
Two cars in lane 3: merging past the first car is fine, the cell past the second is not.
With only one car in the lane, the lane is open beyond it
A lone car can be passed like the first of two.
A full row cannot be passed: occupied cells are never driven through
With no free way round, nothing beyond the row is offered, in any lane.
